rationale: Independent review accepted the author draft without semantic edits after reading the complete original input and checking every quoted source and offset. The only executable obligation is the whole-trip WALK/TRANSIT restriction. Fairly full pace and active use of both days are soft; gardens, major city sights and views are soft themes. The destination, inclusive dates, two adult travelers and SGD 800 budget remain original input facts, with no factual affordability PASS or numerical daily quota inferred. The reviewer independently authored source-bound rich density, route policy, destination timezone and a three-interest inventory. No Planner output, interpretation, trace, score, benchmark README or case result/report was read.
